findings.title: XSS vulnerability in /page endpoint
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' query parameter in the HTML response without proper sanitization. While 'script' tags and single quotes are filtered, double-quote payloads bypass the filter.

reproduction.expected: XSS alert triggered, flag returned in response
